messages.subject: Deducer  with Debian Squeeze amd 64 bits : JGR and R closing when trying a run from the plot builder of Deducer
parts:
Dear Developpers of Deducer,

Hello,

I am a scientist in agricultural soil science and I work since several
months entirely on GNU / Linux Debian (currently with version
squeeze). I'm satisfied with f Debian which is now my system of
everyday.
For everyday work I have no problem sharing data and knowledge about
softwares with other colleagues and with our students. ..except for
statistical analyses : Actually even if some of our colleagues and
many of our students try to use R they are generally a bit hesitant
because most of them ignore the existence of R Guis. So when they use
windows they prefer to use software such as Statistica, XLStats
etc .. With Linux the problem is different the most used statistical
environment is R
So the idea is to find a user-friendly GUI for the statistical
analyses that could work equally well on these OS ... This is why
i''m looking for GUIS for R.

Two days ago I discovered the existence of Deducer (So far I only knew
Rcmdr Rkward and Rattle) and the possibilities of Deducer seemed
particularly interesting for customizing graphics so I decided to make
a trial....
I have been able to install R, then JGR and Deducer without apparent
problem.
It has also been possible
to launch JGR and Deducer
to obtain in Deducer the Data Set window
to open data (e.g in csv format)
to have this data in the data view and Variable View
to obtain histograms or bar plots with the interactive submenu of
the menu plots

Unfortunately when i wanted to use the more sophisticated menu "plot
builder I systematically encountered a bug that seems quite similar
to a bug reported in August 18, 2010 for another OS (Windows XP) which
was called "A closing When hitting run from The Plot Builder" .

in the plot builder menu I can choose the variables for a given type
plot, but as soon as i try to run this plot
JGR crashes and this is the message obtained in the terminal :
# A fatal error has been detected by the Java Runtime Environment:
# SIGBUS (0x7) at pc=0x00007f794b93111e, pid=5810,
tid=140158898071296
# JRE version: 6.0_24-b07
# Java VM: Java HotSpot(TM) 64-Bit Server VM (19.1-b02 mixed mode
linux-amd64 compressed oops)
# Problematic frame:
# C [JavaGD.so+0x411e]
# An error report file with more information is saved as:
# /root/hs_err_pid5810.log
# If you would like to submit a bug report, please visit:
# http://java.sun.com/webapps/bugreport/crash.jsp
# The crash happened outside the Java Virtual Machine in native code.
# See problematic frame for where to I would be very glad report the
bug.
Aborted


So i would be very gratefull if i could have any help about this
problem

Kind regards

Didier Blavet (From Montpellier, France)

Dear Ian

Thank you very much for your quick response of this morning and for
your sending of a file deducer.jar

I just discovered now that in all likelihood the problem is upstream
Deducer !
It seems to come from my configuration of JGR because "my" JGR
(under Debian GNU Linux) closes also without Deducer
when i try a simple plot with the command plot(x~y) !!
